subject: Re: Referral program — tracking, split mechanics, and deal protection
messages:
From: Nora Patel <nora@bluearc.io>
To: lauren_bishop <lauren_bishop@redwood.ai>
Cc: BlueArc Legal <legal@bluearc.io>
Date: Sat, 18 Apr 2026 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: Referral program proposal — split mechanics & tracking
Attachments: bluearc-referral-term-draft.xlsx (xlsx)

Hi Lauren,

Thanks again for the demo last week — the integration looks like a great fit for our analytics customers. As discussed, I put together a short draft (attached) that lays out the referral split we typically use for ISV partners and a simple lead-tracking workflow so we don’t get misaligned on credits. High-level: 20% first-year rev-share OR a flat referral fee per closed ARR (your preference), partner-registered leads get exclusive deal protection for 60 days, and credit is assigned via a HubSpot partner token on the initial opportunity.

Can you confirm whether Redwood prefers rev-share or flat referral fees for early ISV pilots? Also want to confirm the expected payout cadence (monthly vs. quarterly) and any mandatory paperwork you need (PO, invoice template, or DocuSign).

If it helps, we can pilot with 3 qualifying leads in Q2 and review metrics at the end of the pilot month.

Attached: draft terms + sample invoice.

Thanks,
Nora Patel
Head of Partnerships | BlueArc Analytics
nora@bluearc.io | +1 415-555-0123

From: lauren_bishop <lauren_bishop@redwood.ai>
To: Nora Patel <nora@bluearc.io>
Cc: ben_carter <ben_carter@redwood.ai>, vivek_kulkarni <vivek_kulkarni@redwood.ai>
Date: Sat, 18 Apr 2026 11:08:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Referral program proposal — split mechanics & tracking
Attachments: (none)

Nora — thanks for the clear draft and the pilot proposal. Looping Ben (sales ops) and Vivek (channels) so we can align on operations and legal touchpoints. A few notes from our side: 

- Payout model: for pilots we prefer flat referral fees (simpler accounting) — propose $10k per closed new customer ARR >= $50k ecosystem-qualified, with a 6-month clawback window tied to cancellations. If the pilot scales, we can move to a tiered percentage (starting at 15% first year).
- Deal protection: agree to partner-registered exclusive protection, but recommend 90 days for enterprise deals > $200k ARR. For smaller deals we’re fine with 60 days.
- Lead registration: we use a HubSpot partner token field + a short intake form. Partner must register the lead before the first sales demo to qualify. Ben — can you confirm the token name and whether we can expose a partner-facing registration link?
- Compliance & Docs: we’ll need a signed SOW/partner addendum and our standard reseller/referral schedule. Also need SOC 2 evidence for any production PII access — Nora, if BlueArc can share your SOC 2 report or an accepted summary, that will speed legal review.

Next steps: Ben, Vivek — if you’re good with the $10k pilot fee and the 90/60 protection split, I’ll route a short partner addendum to BlueArc for signature and turn on a partner token in HubSpot. Nora — once we have that signed we can start the Q2 pilot immediately.

Best,
Lauren Bishop
GM, Strategic Partnerships | Redwood Inference
lauren_bishop@redwood.ai | +1 650-555-0199

Subject: Re: Referral program proposal — tracking, split mechanics & protection
Attachments: example-invoice-template.pdf (pdf)

Lauren / Vivek — quick ops note from Sales Ops perspective: we can expose a partner-facing registration link that auto-tags the opportunity in HubSpot with a "partner_token=BLUEARC" UTM style. That will make attribution deterministic for the registration window. A couple of operational clarifications: 

- Overlap rule: if the same account shows up in our SDR pipeline before partner registration, credit flows to Sales unless Sales assigns to partner within 5 business days with a reroute note. This avoids stale pipeline capture.
- Deal protection: agree to 90 days for enterprise (> $200k). For the pilot (Q2) we can allow 60 days for speed but we should document it in the addendum.
- Payout cadence: Redwood payments team can do monthly payouts for partner fees if BlueArc provides an invoice by the 5th of the month for closed deals in the previous month. We use net-30 payment terms.

I attached our invoice template for BlueArc to use — keeps AP in sync.

Ben Carter
Head of Sales Ops | Redwood Inference
ben_carter@redwood.ai

Thanks Lauren & Ben — all sounds reasonable. Confirming:

- BlueArc accepts the $10k flat referral for qualifying pilot deals and will provide signed addendum once you route the DocuSign.
- We agree to the 60-day protection for pilot deals and will accept 90-day protection for enterprise > $200k in the long run.
- We will use the invoice template Ben attached and submit invoices by the 5th of each month. Monthly payout with net-30 is fine.
- For overlap detection, we’ll add internal rules so we only register leads that are not already in your pipeline; Nora from Legal will follow up with any contract language edits but no major issues expected.

Next step: Lauren — if you can share the partner addendum DocuSign link (and the HubSpot registration link), we’ll sign and schedule the first pilot demo for Apr 28.

Appreciate the quick turnaround — excited to get this rolling.

Best,
Nora
